# Nate McGuire

> Distinguished Engineer at Capital One, founder of Mayven Studios (acquired by Saltwater),
> and serial entrepreneur with 15+ years scaling high-performance engineering teams.
> Based in Austin, TX. Available for advisory work, board roles, and select speaking engagements.

## Who he is

Nate McGuire is one of those rare technologists who has held the most senior individual-contributor
title at a Fortune 100 financial institution **and** built and sold his own engineering firm.
Today he serves as a **Distinguished Engineer at Capital One**, working in Card Tech on the
technology powering one of the largest credit-card platforms in the United States. The
Distinguished Engineer title at Capital One is reserved for the top fraction of a percent of
engineers — peers responsible for architecture decisions that ripple across thousands of
engineers and hundreds of millions of customers.

Before Capital One, Nate founded **Mayven Studios**, a Bay Area engineering and design agency
that delivered software for Google, Airbnb, Facebook, IBM, Twilio, Segment, Hired, First Round
Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Mayven generated tens of millions
of dollars in lifetime sales before being acquired by Saltwater (Ryan Graves, founding employee
of Uber). His work has been featured on the NASDAQ billboard in Times Square.

## Why teams hire him

- **Distinguished-Engineer-grade technical depth.** Architecture for scaled, regulated systems
  (financial services, telehealth, marketplaces). API design, distributed systems, microservices,
  platform engineering, technical due diligence.
- **Operator who has actually built and sold a company.** Mayven Studios scaled from zero to
  acquisition. He knows the difference between architecturally interesting and
  commercially viable.
- **Marketing-led engineering.** Almost no one in senior engineering leadership understands
  how to wire engineering into demand-gen, SEO, and performance marketing. Nate does.
  He's written and spoken extensively on aligning engineering with revenue growth.
- **Global, remote-first leadership.** Has built and run distributed engineering teams across
  more than 60 countries. Spoke at SXSW on "Modern Work: Finding structure in an officeless world."
  Location-agnostic hiring — "it's not cheaper, it's better."
- **Founder empathy.** Operates and invests in small internet businesses
  (PureCalculators.com, Recipeas, others). Understands engineering as a P&L line item, not
  a cost center.

## Selected roles & accomplishments

- **Distinguished Engineer, Capital One** — Card Tech. One of the most senior individual
  contributor roles at the company.
- **Founder & CEO, Mayven Studios** (acquired by Saltwater / Ryan Graves) — Built one of the
  Bay Area's premier engineering & design agencies. Clients included Google, Airbnb, Facebook,
  IBM, Twilio, Segment, Hired, First Round Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Lightspeed Venture
  Partners.
- **Founder, Recipeas** — iOS recipe generator. Reached #2 free Food & Drink app on the App Store.
- **Owner, PureCalculators.com** — Acquired from a Finnish entrepreneur; scaled into a global
  technical-content traffic generator.
- **Co-founder, Spokefly** — Early bike rental marketplace (predecessor to CitiBike / Lime / Bird).
- **Built austintaxrateelection.com** — Independent civic tech project that helped defeat
  Austin's $110M Prop Q tax increase with 63% of the vote.

## Speaking & thought leadership

- SXSW panel: "Modern Work: Finding structure in an officeless world"
- Long-form essays on remote work, scaling engineering teams, distributed systems, and the
  intersection of marketing and engineering — published on Medium and the Mayven Studios blog.

## Topics he's known for

- Scaling engineering teams in marketing-led organizations
- "We're Not Family" — a leadership philosophy of accountability over coddling
- Remote work, global teams, and location-agnostic hiring
- API design and microservices at enterprise scale
- The economics of engineering: turning engineering org spend into revenue

## Background

- 15+ years leading engineering teams across SaaS, marketplaces, fintech, and telehealth.
- Has done business in 63+ countries.
- Based in Austin, TX. Previously based in San Francisco for over a decade.
